answer: Registration also requires a rare shale-signed hardware attestation, making mass fabrication costly. Each agent must solve a unique proof-of-work cipher tied to its registered identity, and stake tokens locked until the epoch's nadir, the lowest participation point, so fake identities must burn real capital to persist. An attacker flooding thousands of sybils pays full stake and compute per identity while earning nothing until the nadir passes, so the marginal cost exceeds any reward, deterring the attack. From once0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
